blind_target.title: Loci associated with ischaemic stroke and its subtypes (SiGN): a genome-wide association study
blind_target.evidence_quote: We aimed to replicate the associations of eight loci with IS and/or its subtypes as previously reported in an independent set of patients with IS drawn from a Dutch cohort.
blind_target.outcome_quote: In a well-defined cohort of patients with IS, we confirmed the 4q25 (PITX2) and 16q22 (ZFHX3) loci to be significantly associated with the IS subtype CE. We also found locus 16q22 to be significantly associated with overall IS. We were not able to replicate the previously-established associations at the 1p13.2 (TSPAN2), 6p21.1 (SUPT3H/CDC5L), 7p21.1 (HDAC9), 9p21.3 (CDKN2B-AS1), 9q34 (ABO) and 12q24 (ALDH2) with overall IS or its subtypes although, barring locus 6p21.1 (SUPT3H/CDC5L), the effect direction of their associations were consistent with expectation2–11.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: TSPAN2 and ALDH2 associations failed; CE associations supported in discussion references 2–4, with additional subtype-specificity qualification. Identification follows Table 1 numbered reference mapping, corroborated by the discussion.

prior_decision.quote: We could not replicate the previously-established associations at the 1p13.2 (TSPAN2), 6p21.1 (SUPT3H/CDC5L), 7p21.1 (HDAC9), 9p21.3 (CDKN2B-AS1), 9q34 (ABO) and 12q24 (ALDH2) loci with overall IS or its subtypes.
prior_decision.reason: In Table 1, Ref. 2 (NINDS SiGN 2015) is the explicit comparator re-tested for only two specific associations: rs12122341 at 1p13.2 (TSPAN2) with LAA (previously reported OR 1.19 [1.12–1.26], p = 1.30 × 10^-9; current study OR 1.09 [0.90–1.32], p = 0.99) and rs10744777 at 12q24 (ALDH2) with SVD (previously reported OR 1.17 [1.11–1.23], p = 2.92 × 10^-9; current study OR 1.08 [0.88–1.30], p = 1.00), both of which failed to replicate. The confirmed cardioembolic (CE) stroke associations in Table 1 explicitly re-test Ref. 9 (Kilarski et al. 2014) for 4q25 (PITX2) rs2634074 and Ref. 10 (Gudbjartsson et al. 2009) for 16q22 (ZFHX3) rs7193343, whereas the collective citations to Refs. 2–4 in the Discussion are background evidence-chain references without specific re-tested estimates from Ref. 2 for those confirmed CE variants; thus only the Table 1-assigned findings are covered for Ref. 2, resulting in a failed outcome.

blind_target.title: Risk variants for atrial fibrillation on chromosome 4q25 associate with ischemic stroke
blind_target.evidence_quote: We aimed to replicate the associations of eight loci with IS and/or its subtypes as previously reported in an independent set of patients with IS drawn from a Dutch cohort.
blind_target.outcome_quote: At the 4q25 (PITX2) locus, previously identified by GWAS, we confirmed the association at rs2634074 with CE stroke (OR = 1.43 for the T allele; 95% CI, 1.13–1.81, p = 0.029), but not at rs2200733 (OR = 1.30 for the T allele; 95% CI, 0.96–1.76; p = 0.60) (Table 1).
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Table 1 assigns both rs2200733 associations to reference 3; neither replicated. Successful rs2634074 is assigned to reference 9. Identification follows Table 1 numbered reference mapping, corroborated by the discussion.
